name: Inline edit help
description: Help mode entries for the Inline edit plugin (help@1): the master switch, the edit dialog and the overrides list.
author: Brett

entries.title: Inline edit settings
entries.text: The Inline edit mode switch, a shortcut to the overrides list, and installing or removing the plugin.

entries.title: Inline edit mode
entries.text: The master switch. On: right-click any element of the console, down to a single menu row, nav item, toolbar button or banner widget, to edit its tokens. Off: right-click works as usual. Alt + right-click always opens the normal menu.

entries.title: Overrides
entries.text: Every value changed from what axHub passes down. Search and filter it, pick a root in the tree or give each tab its own root, and reset any single item to axHub.

entries.title: Edit element
entries.text: Every token of the element you right-clicked. The path at the top runs from the root down to the element; tap a step to edit that parent instead. Each token shows what it inherits from axHub, and a change here overrides that.

entries.title: Apply changes to
entries.text: This item only, or this item and everything under it, or everything under one of its parents. An item override beats a parent one.

entries.title: View
entries.text: Tree groups the tokens by kind, Classic tree shows the element and every parent with their tokens, and Grid is a table whose rows open to the editor.

entries.title: Revert to axHub
entries.text: Removes just this one override, so the token goes back to what it inherits from axHub. Nothing else changes.

entries.title: Reset to axHub
entries.text: Removes only this override and updates the list at once. A parent override reaches everything under it, so it asks first.

entries.title: All overrides
entries.text: Closes the dialog and opens the overrides list.

entries.title: Done
entries.text: Closes the dialog. Changes are already saved.

entries.title: Open the overrides list
entries.text: Opens the list of every value changed from axHub's inheritance.

entries.title: Roots
entries.text: One tab per root you keep coming back to (a toolbar, a menu, a nav section). Tabs are kept for you. Plus adds a tab with the root selected now.

entries.title: Root
entries.text: Shows only what is changed under this element. Everything shows it all.

entries.title: Search
entries.text: Finds overrides by element, token, value, who changed it or why.

entries.title: Clear
entries.text: Clears the search and every filter.

entries.title: Edit
entries.text: Opens the edit dialog on this element at this scope.

entries.title: Inline edit overrides
entries.text: Opens the list of every value changed from axHub's inheritance.

entries.title: Inline edit mode
entries.text: Turns inline edit mode on or off: on, right-click any element to edit its tokens.

entries.title: Overrides list
entries.text: Opens the list of every value changed from axHub's inheritance, where each one can be reset.

entries.title: New tab
entries.text: Adds a tab to the column that keeps the root selected now, so you can come back to it.

entries.title: Changed since
entries.text: Shows only overrides changed on or after this day.

entries.title: Until
entries.text: Shows only overrides changed on or before this day.

entries.title: Edit here
entries.text: Makes this parent the one your edits go to: they then reach it and everything under it.

steps.say: Everything changed from what axHub passes down is listed here, newest values against what axHub would give.
Pick a root in the tree on the left, or give each tab its own root, to narrow the list.
Reset to axHub on any row puts back only that one item.
